Food safety body issues notices to energy drink companies over misbranding

India's food safety regulator, FSSAI, has issued notices to several major energy drink brands, including Red Bull, PepsiCo, and Monster. The notices are related to alleged misbranding of their products. This action by the FSSAI highlights regulatory scrutiny over the labeling and marketing of popular beverages.
